criteria.matches_direction: The complete assembly retains the mockup's broad low bench, four short feet, two narrow uprights, open loom center, top beam and single copper roller.
criteria.geometry_uvs: All structure pieces use the existing slab, quarter-beam and eighth-cell geometry. The custom controller face exports as an opaque 32x32, 20-color texture with broad oak, ivory cloth, indigo, copper and iron regions.
criteria.material_consistency: Faithful oak remains authoritative on construction blocks; the controller's woven insert directly matches the established Cloth material identity.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: The controller remains front-center, the roller is supported between posts, the center stays open and all required pieces use the existing saw-cut placement and guide system.
criteria.animation_states: The structure is static; existing controller active/fire state and ambient light behavior are unchanged.
criteria.native_size_readability: The pale swatch and blue selvage remain the dominant textile landmark at 32x; dark framing and the copper bearing remain subordinate.
